baseline.value: Level 1- CPIMS+ data based rolled out led by humanitarian sector with 32 NGOs using the system across country

target.value: 2025:Level 4 -An integrated case management system for government and humanitarian child protection workers implemented in at least 3 States

actual.value: 2024:Level 3 of the CPIMS+ was operational in South Sudan; 400+ users and 30+ CP area of responsibility members are registered; they documented over 40,000 cases of children who are at risk of violence and required services.
